rootCause.summary: The accepted host reached PREPARE_WORKER_DELIVERY_INTENT after acquiring the worker-delivery lease, but the effective host-000026 runtime composition did not produce a durably read-back prepared intent. The runner then safely released/reconciled and stopped before send. Static launcher inspection shows the preparation function property is bound; the runtime failure is therefore at the preparation adapter/persistence result seam, with insufficient error propagation to identify a narrower sub-cause.
callChain: evaluateAutomaticDispatchHost -> HOST_MUTATION_LEASE_REQUIRED when no valid worker lease is present
non-PREPARED or non-durable preparation -> releaseMutationLease -> RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED / WORKER_DELIVERY_INTENT_PREPARATION_REQUIRED
rootCause.notObserved: No durable preparation error detail was recorded by the accepted runner; the event is intentionally fail-closed and reports only the stable reason code.

answers.q1: evaluateAutomaticDispatchHost produces HOST_DELIVERY_READY with nextAction PREPARE_WORKER_DELIVERY_INTENT after governance and lease evaluation succeed.
answers.q2: Yes. browser-relay-transport-ports.js exports prepareWorkerDeliveryIntent; it creates, validates, persists, and read-backs through the injected worker persistence adapter before any browser observation.
answers.q3: Yes. persistent-host-runner.js automatically calls ports.prepareWorkerDeliveryIntent after lease acquisition and before sendWorkerDelivery. It does not merely emit the action.
answers.q4: No. automatic-dispatch-host.js evaluates lifecycle state and returns the action boundary; it does not perform intent preparation.
answers.q5: github-runtime-ports.js provides durable GitHub JSON read/create/CAS and lease/runtime persistence primitives. The preparation method itself is supplied by browser-relay-transport-ports.js and requires an injected worker persistence adapter.
answers.q6: Yes. sendWorkerDelivery requires request.preparedIntent, validates its exact lineage, and returns FAILED_BEFORE_SEND with WORKER_INTENT_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED if it is absent or invalid.
answers.q7: The launcher statically binds relayPorts.prepareWorkerDeliveryIntent, relayPorts.sendWorkerDelivery, and relayPorts.sendArchitectTrigger into ports. Durable evidence nevertheless proves that preparation did not return the required PREPARED/durable intent. The incorrect effective seam is the runtime preparation adapter/persistence composition or its unreported failure, not a missing property binding.
answers.q8: COMPOSITION_WIRING_DEFECT. This is the accepted composition's effective preparation seam failure; no source or dispatch metadata repair was authorized or attempted.
answers.q9: The host derives lease need from the evaluated worker-delivery action and its required resource/lineage lease descriptor. automatic-dispatch-host.js forces the pre-dispatch policy to non-mutating for eligibility, then independently evaluates the worker lease with evaluateMutationLeaseUse; absence of an authorized lease returns HOST_MUTATION_LEASE_REQUIRED. Thus the dispatch booleans did not suppress the action-derived lease boundary; they are metadata inconsistent with the accepted host contract, not flags the host ignored as an authoritative override.
answers.q10: Smallest next repair boundary: first repair the disposable host composition so the injected preparation adapter returns a durable read-back intent and propagates its stable failure reason; do not change dispatch metadata. If composition inspection proves the accepted runner/transport contract itself is defective, make the smallest source repair in persistent-host-runner.js or the transport-port adapter and add its focused regression test, then qualify under a fresh authorized dispatch/host lineage.
answers.q11: Potential source files/functions/tests only if composition repair is insufficient: src/host/persistent-host-runner.js (runPersistentHostIteration preparation branch), src/host/browser-relay-transport-ports.js (prepareWorkerDeliveryIntent and its persistence contract), possibly src/host/github-runtime-ports.js only if its injected persistence contract is proven insufficient; focused tests persistent-host-runner.test.js, browser-relay-transport-ports.test.js, and github-runtime-ports.test.js. No file was modified.
answers.q12: Host 000026 was not restarted, replaced, or stopped. PID 16880 was alive during inspection. Its durable ORCH-000167/000168 activity shows repeated lease/reconciliation cycles rather than a terminal circuit-open state; it is not a safe candidate for further mutation under this diagnostic. Later repair should use a fresh host identity/generation after Architect authorization, unless the Architect explicitly governs a safe stop/replacement.
